title: Famine Drives Elimelech's Family to Moab

title: Naomi Decides to Return to Bethlehem
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, Naomi hears in Moab that the Lord has visited His people in Judah and given them food again. She prepares to leave with her two daughters-in-law, Orpah and Ruth, and they begin walking toward the road that leads back to Judah. She blesses them and prays that the Lord will deal kindly with them as they had dealt with their deceased husbands and with her. Naomi hopes that they may find rest in the homes of new husbands. The women weep together, initially insisting that they will accompany her, but Naomi argues that she has no other sons for them to marry and sees no future security for them in remaining with her. Orpah eventually kisses Naomi and returns to her people, while Ruth remains. Show the farewell on a dusty Moabite road, Orpah departing toward her homeland and Ruth standing beside Naomi. title: Ruth Commits Herself to Naomi and Israel's God

title: Naomi and Ruth Arrive in Bethlehem

title: Ruth Gleans in the Field of Boaz
image_prompt: Extremely detailed biblical historical realism, Naomi has a relative through her husband Elimelech named Boaz, a wealthy and respected man of the clan of Elimelech. title: Boaz Shows Kindness and Protection to Ruth

title: Naomi Recognizes Boaz as a Close Relative

title: Ruth Approaches Boaz at the Threshing Floor
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, Ruth goes quietly to the threshing floor after Boaz has finished winnowing the barley, eating and drinking. Boaz lies down near the heap of grain. title: Boaz Meets the Nearer Redeemer at the City Gate
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, Boaz goes to the town gate of Bethlehem, the public place where elders and legal matters are handled.
